name: How do I choose the right window casing style for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right window casing style for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose casing profiles that align with your home's existing baseboards, crown molding, and architectural era. Traditional homes benefit from colonial or multi-profile molded casing with mitered corners. Craftsman, farmhouse, and contemporary spaces often use flat-stock casing with butt joints and a decorative header or stool cap. For rooms where you plan to paint the trim, smooth pre-primed MDF or pine provides an even finish. If you want natural wood grain or have stained cabinetry nearby, choose stain-grade hardwood such as oak or poplar to maintain visual consistency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match the profile to your existing baseboards and home style: flat-stock for craftsman or modern homes, and profiled, mitered molding for traditional architecture.
